# Graphics fixture content

Everything in this folder and in `../Scenes` was written by hand or generated by
`../Tools/generate.py` for the Shockwave repository, and is covered by the repository's
license, with one exception below. No downloaded or commercial assets are used.

`effects/upstream/distortion.efk` is Effekseer's own distortion example
(Examples/Resources/distortion.efk in https://github.com/effekseer/Effekseer, version
1.7.3.0), kept unchanged so tests can read an effect made in Effekseer's editor. Its
textures aren't included. It is under the MIT License:
